text.p: These are the leading stories in the official Syrian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Syrian President Assad sends message to Libyan leader Gaddafi on latest regional developments and the peace process.
- Lebanon patriots attack pro-Israeli militia in south Lebanon.
- Egyptian President Mubarak says Mideast peace can not be achieved without Syria.
- Syrian cabinet discusses the budget for 1997.
- The U.S. says Lebanon is no longer drugs producer.
- Military cooperation between Washington and Tel Aviv. Turkey and Israel to carry out joint exercises.
